title: Pure Infernal Flame
summary: The Infernal Flame strategy revolves around the explosive GY-banishing synergies of Infernal Flame Emperor and its companion Xyz monsters, Infernal Flame Banshee and Infernal Flame Vixen. Infernal Flame Banshee searches any Pyro monster on detach and Special Summons itself whenever banished while you control a Pyro. Tributing for the 2700 ATK Infernal Flame Emperor banishes multiple FIRE monsters from the GY to wipe opposing backrow, triggering Banshee's return to establish an overwhelming aggressive board.

allow.Neo Flamvell Lady: Level 4 FIRE Pyro that banishes a card from the opponent's GY as a Quick Effect and dumps a 200 DEF FIRE Pyro from Deck to GY.
allow.Royal Firestorm Guards: Level 4 FIRE Pyro that shuffles 4 Pyro monsters from your GY into the Deck to draw 2 cards.
allow.Flamvell Firedog: Level 4 FIRE monster that summons Neo Flamvell Lady from the Deck on battle destruction for an instant Rank 4 Xyz Summon.
allow.Blaster, Dragon Ruler of Infernos: Banishes 2 FIRE monsters from your hand or GY (including Infernal Flame Banshee to immediately revive her!) to Special Summon itself.
allow.Rekindling: Revives 200 DEF FIRE Pyros (Neo Flamvell Lady, Flamvell Firedog) to immediately Xyz Summon Infernal Flame Vixen and Infernal Flame Banshee.
allow.Circle of the Fire Kings: Quick-Play Spell that destroys Infernal Flame Vixen to revive Infernal Flame Emperor or Infernal Flame Banshee from your GY.

main: Infernal Flame Emperor

Signature Level 9 FIRE Pyro boss (2700 ATK / 1600 DEF; directly searchable by Infernal Flame Banshee!): when Tribute Summoned, banishes up to 5 FIRE monsters from your GY (triggering Infernal Flame Banshee!) to destroy an equal number of Spell/Trap Cards on the field.
Spirit of Flames

Level 4 FIRE Pyro (1700 ATK): banishes 1 FIRE monster from your GY (including Infernal Flame Banshee, immediately reviving Banshee!) to Special Summon itself from your hand and gains 300 ATK during your Battle Phase.
Solar Flare Dragon
Level 4 FIRE Pyro (1500 ATK): cannot be attacked while you control another Pyro monster, burns for 500 every End Phase, and overlays into Infernal Flame Vixen.
Neo Flamvell Lady
Level 4 FIRE Pyro (200 DEF): sends a FIRE monster from hand to GY as a Quick Effect to banish a card from the opponent's GY, and dumps a 200 DEF FIRE monster from Deck to GY.
Royal Firestorm Guards
Level 4 FIRE Pyro (1700 ATK) that recycles 4 Pyro monsters from your GY into the Deck to draw 2 cards.
Flamvell Firedog
Level 4 FIRE monster (1900 ATK / 200 DEF) that summons Neo Flamvell Lady from the Deck to immediately overlay into Infernal Flame Banshee or Infernal Flame Vixen.
Blaster, Dragon Ruler of Infernos
Banishes 2 FIRE monsters from your hand/GY to Special Summon itself from hand or GY.
Bonfire
Limited to 1 in TCG: adds any Level 4 or lower Pyro monster (Spirit of Flames, Solar Flare Dragon, or Neo Flamvell Lady) from your Deck to your hand.
Rekindling
Special Summons Neo Flamvell Lady and Flamvell Firedog from your GY to assemble both Infernal Flame Banshee and Infernal Flame Vixen in a single turn.
Circle of the Fire Kings
Destroys Infernal Flame Vixen on the field to revive Infernal Flame Emperor or Infernal Flame Banshee from your GY.
extra: Signature Rank 4 FIRE Pyro Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters): detaches 1 material to add ANY Pyro monster from your Deck to your hand or send it to the GY; if banished while you control a Pyro monster, Special Summons itself and gains +100 ATK per banished monster!

Signature Rank 4 FIRE Pyro Xyz (2 FIRE Pyro-Type monsters; 2200 ATK): detaches 1 material to gain 500 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn; when destroyed on the field, banishes up to 3 monsters from either GY!
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
